# OpusEncoderOptions

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Opus` · class

```csharp
public sealed class OpusEncoderOptions
```

The settings of an [`OpusEncoder`](OpusEncoder.md): libopus's, with opusenc's defaults, so setting nothing encodes as `opusenc` does with no options.

## Properties

### Application

```csharp
public OpusApplication Application { get; init; }
```

Types: [`OpusApplication`](OpusApplication.md)

What the encoder is tuned for. The default is general audio, as opusenc's.

### Bitrate

```csharp
public int? Bitrate { get; init; }
```

The target bitrate in bits a second (opusenc's `--bitrate`, in kbit/s there): 500 to 750,000 a channel. `null` is opusenc's default: 64 kbit/s for each Opus stream and 32 more for each coupled (stereo) one, so 64 for mono, 96 for stereo and 320 for 5.1 at 48 kHz, scaled down by (rate + 16 kHz) / 64 kHz for inputs below 44.1 kHz.

### BitrateMode

```csharp
public OpusBitrateMode BitrateMode { get; init; }
```

Types: [`OpusBitrateMode`](OpusBitrateMode.md)

How the bitrate is held (opusenc's `--vbr`, `--cvbr`, `--hard-cbr`). The default is VBR.

### Complexity

```csharp
public int Complexity { get; init; }
```

The encoder's effort, 0 (fastest) to 10 (best; the default), as opusenc's `--comp`.

### Dtx

```csharp
public bool Dtx { get; init; }
```

Whether silence is sent as rare, tiny packets (discontinuous transmission).

### ExpectedPacketLoss

```csharp
public int ExpectedPacketLoss { get; init; }
```

The packet loss to expect, 0 to 100 percent (opusenc's `--expect-loss`). The default is 0.

### FrameDuration

```csharp
public OpusFrameDuration FrameDuration { get; init; }
```

Types: [`OpusFrameDuration`](OpusFrameDuration.md)

The duration of each packet (opusenc's `--framesize`). The default is 20 ms. Packets of 40 ms or more are several frames each.

### InbandFec

```csharp
public bool InbandFec { get; init; }
```

Whether packets carry forward error correction for the one before (SILK and hybrid modes, with [`ExpectedPacketLoss`](#expectedpacketloss)).

### MaxBandwidth

```csharp
public OpusBandwidth MaxBandwidth { get; init; }
```

Types: [`OpusBandwidth`](OpusBandwidth.md)

The widest audio bandwidth coded. The default, fullband, lets the encoder choose by bitrate.

### PhaseInversion

```csharp
public bool PhaseInversion { get; init; }
```

Whether stereo may use phase inversion, which codes stereo better but sounds worse downmixed to mono. The default is yes; opusenc's `--no-phase-inv` is `false`.

### Signal

```csharp
public OpusSignal Signal { get; init; }
```

Types: [`OpusSignal`](OpusSignal.md)

A hint of what the signal is (opusenc's `--music`, `--speech`). The default is to detect it.
